title: refactor(plugin-view,plugin-grid,types): retire table.defaultSort / object-grid defaultSort (ADR-0049)
body:
Fixes #5861
Clause-②: yes — this removes the last runtime reads and the declared docs of a key the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 already refuses by name; the published grid/view props surface narrows.

## What this does

ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, remove arm, for `object-grid`'s `defaultSort` and `object-view`'s `table.defaultSort` — the "C half" of the maintainer's 2026-08-22 ruling on objectui#4869 (「接受所有」), restart condition measured by triage comment 5808485875.

Every reader is removed in one change, so no path honours the key while another ignores it:

| Reader | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ObjectGrid` fetch path | third arm `else if (schema.defaultSort)` lowered it to `$orderby` | chain reads `sort` only |
| `ObjectGrid` header arrows | `parseSchemaSort(schemaSort ?? [schema.defaultSort])` | `parseSchemaSort(schemaSort)` |
| `ObjectView` non-grid fetch | fourth branch lowered `table.defaultSort` into the sink | chain ends at `table.sort` |
| `ObjectView` grid forwarding | `defaultSort: schema.table?.defaultSort` | not forwarded |
| `ObjectView` delegated `renderListView` | `mergedSort` wrapped `table.defaultSort` into an array | chain ends at `table.sort` |
| `plugin-grid` registration | `sort` input described `defaultSort` as its fallback | description says it is retired |

## H1 — the TypeScript declaration goes too, as a tombstone (decided and measured)

`ObjectGridSchema.defaultSort` becomes `defaultSort?: never` and the zod mirror member becomes `retirementTombstone(...)`, in lockstep. Not a deletion: `ObjectGridSchema` extends `BaseSchema`, whose `[key: string]: any` absorbs an undeclared key as `any`, and the mirror's `.passthrough()` keeps it unexamined, so deleting would let the retired spelling type-check and parse green and do nothing. This is the package's existing convention (`ObjectViewSchema.viewTabBar`, objectui#7779). Measured on the rebuilt `dist`: a downstream `ObjectGridSchema` literal carrying `defaultSort` fails `tsc` in `plugin-view` with TS2322 (reverse check below). Only the `defaultSort` regions of `objectql.ts` / `objectql.zod.ts` were touched; `ObjectGridSlotKey` keeps listing the key because the member is still declared.

## H2 — no live producer (measured, with lit controls)

- Installed spec 17.4.0: `ObjectGridPropsSchema.safeParse({ objectName, defaultSort })` fails `invalid_type` at `defaultSort` with the message "`object-grid` property `defaultSort` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0049) — it was the legacy second spelling of `sort` …"; control `{ objectName, sort: [...] }` parses green.
- No non-test source outside the edited files reads the key (`git grep defaultSort -- packages/` — the remaining hits are `plugin-detail`'s own `RelatedList` `defaultSort` prop, a different carrier fed from `schema.sort`, plus CHANGELOGs). `normalize-list-view` never mentions it.
- Authored occurrences — objectui: `examples/` 0 files, `e2e/` 0, `apps/` 1 (the registry parity test's comments, not authoring), `content/` 2 (the two pages tombstoned here). objectstack `origin/main`: `examples/` 0, `apps/` 0, `packages/qa/` 0. Lit control, identical method, `searchableFields`: objectui `examples/` 4 files, `content/` 5; objectstack `examples/` 2, `packages/qa/` 1.
- ⚠️ One authored occurrence the earlier reads did not flag: the `ObjectGridSchema` JSON example in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` authored `"defaultSort": { "field": "name", "order": "asc" }` — a copy-paste of it is refused by the spec. It now authors `"sort": [{ "field": "name", "order": "asc" }]`.

## H3 — pins, red on the base and green on the head

The flipped cells were rewritten, not deleted: each now asserts the key is inert on its path, beside a canonical `sort` control on the same path in the same run.

Red leg: the five source files were put back to the base `59636b3a6` under the committed tests, with a trap restore (blob hashes re-checked against HEAD afterwards, `git diff HEAD` empty): **19 failed | 97 passed (116)**, 8 of 9 files red. The only all-green file is `gridRetiredStringSort-8767.test.tsx`, whose cell was only re-commented. Green leg on the head: **116 passed (116)**, 9 files.

Flipped or new, each red on base:

- `plugin-view` `ObjectView.canonicalTableKeys.test.tsx` — grid path: `no longer forwards a retired table.defaultSort — and does not rescue it into sort`; `puts the canonical value in the canonical slot…` (legacy slot now undefined); `keeps the named view sort in force, and a retired table.defaultSort beside it is not forwarded`. Non-grid: `a retired table.defaultSort alone orders NOTHING`. Delegated: `hands over NO sort for a retired table.defaultSort alone`.
- `plugin-view` `ObjectView.sortSink.test.tsx` — `sends no $orderby at all…`, `a descending legacy default is inert too…`, and the tail of `keeps the sink STRICT…` (the sink-strictness half is unchanged).
- `plugin-view` `ObjectView.filterSources.test.tsx` — the three objectui#6235 wrap cells, flipped.
- `plugin-view` `ObjectView.namedViewSortArity.test.tsx` — through the REAL `ObjectGrid`: `a retired table.defaultSort sorts NOTHING on the real grid path — no $orderby, no arrow`, plus a new canonical `table.sort` control cell.
- `plugin-grid` `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973.test.tsx` — the legacy-arm section, flipped (fully-specified, and `order` omitted, now send no `$orderby`).
- `plugin-grid` `gridDefaultFiltersLowering.test.tsx` — `a retired defaultSort reaches neither $orderby nor $filter`.
- `plugin-grid` `serverSorting.test.tsx` — new: `a retired defaultSort lights NO arrow and sends NO $orderby`, with a sortable-chrome non-vacuity check.
- `types` `object-grid-default-sort-tombstone-5861.test.ts` — new: refused by name (`invalid_type` at `defaultSort`), lit control (unknown key green), remedy text, describe equals message, canonical `sort` green, upstream re-derivation from the installed pin, and the `@ts-expect-error` on the `?: never` twin (compiled by `tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFiles` includes the file).

Canonical `sort` is asserted on all three `ObjectView` paths and on bare `ObjectGrid` in the same runs.

## Review rework (head `28b1a4d32`)

The contract review at `f40819d61` (comment 5828759786) returned FAIL on two items and one nit. All three are addressed in `28b1a4d32`:

1. **Required `Test` was red** on `scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts` ("records every version literal on the scanned surfaces"). The doc tombstones had added unregistered `@objectstack/spec` version literals in `plugin-view.mdx` and `plugin-view/README.md`, plus a third in `schema-reference.md` split across a line break, which the gate cannot see. The gate's preferred remedy is applied to all three: the literal is deleted, and each page now says the installed protocol refuses the key by name. No `KNOWN_CLAIMS` entry is added. Reproduced red locally first (`Tests  1 failed | 28 passed (29)`, naming both visible sites), then green (`29 passed (29)`). No line this PR adds under `content/` or `packages/plugin-view/README.md` carries a version-shaped token.
2. **Pending changesets that would publish "keeps working" beside "no longer read".** Following the precedent of PRs #9139, #9723 and #9734, the falsified sentence in each is put in the past tense for its own change ("at this change …"), and each now names objectui#5861: four carry a dated note, and `5293` carries an inline citation in #9139's form:
   - `objectview-sort-sink-4869.md`: "both spellings of the pair keep working", and the `table.defaultSort` sink chain;
   - `6235-mergedsort-wrap.md`: the delegated-slot wrap;
   - `8973-grid-orderby-normalize.md`: the legacy arm "is fixed with it";
   - `grid-default-filters-lowering-4082.md`: the legacy leg "needs no change";
   - `5293-view-sort-order-spelling.md`: `ObjectGridSchema.defaultSort` cited as a live `order` spelling.

   A re-grep of the pending set finds three more `defaultSort` mentions, all still true and left alone. `7122` says the spec made the key a D2 tombstone. `8767` quotes the spec's retirement text. `6697` concerns `RelatedList`'s own `defaultSortKey`, a different carrier. The retirement changeset's "supersedes" paragraph now names all five entries.
3. **Nit.** The objectui#5270 comment block in `ObjectView.tsx` no longer quotes the retired `defaultSort` header and fetch readers in the present tense.

The branch was not merged with `main`. There was no conflict and CI did not need it; the review reads `behind`, not `dirty`.

## Gates (code commit `43ab1fd43`; rework head `28b1a4d32`; full-suite runs at `f40819d61`, and `plugin-view` re-run at `28b1a4d32`)

- Build closure: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-view^...' --concurrency=2`: 15 successful, 15 total; rebuilt `packages/types/dist/objectql.d.ts` carries `defaultSort?: never`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0 (script echoed `@object-ui/types@17.6.0 type-check`); `@object-ui/plugin-grid` exit 0; `@object-ui/plugin-view` exit 0.
- Reverse type check through the rebuilt `.d.ts`: injecting `defaultSort: { field: "name", order: "asc" }` into `ObjectView`'s `gridSchema` literal makes `plugin-view` `tsc --noEmit` fail with `TS2322 … Types of property 'defaultSort' are incompatible … not assignable to type 'undefined'`; restored, blob equals HEAD. (A first attempt was a no-op: `ablation-replace` refused because the replacement contained its own anchor. It changed nothing and ran nothing.)
- Root-form vitest: `packages/types/` 233 files, 5166 tests passed; `packages/plugin-grid/` 156 files, 1487 tests passed; `packages/plugin-view/` 48 files, 444 tests passed (re-run at `28b1a4d32` together with `doc-version-claims`: 49 files, 473 tests passed; `plugin-view` type-check exit 0 again, closure build 15/15 cached); `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` (it reads the `plugin-grid` registration inputs) 199 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0 (14 source files of 3 released packages, 1 changeset); `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0; `check-changeset-fixed` exit 0.
- `check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`; `check:control-bytes` OK.
- Doc gates: `check-doc-links` exit 0; `check:doc-types` exit 0; `check:doc-fences` exit 0; `check:doc-example-ids` exit 0; `check-prompt-component-keys` exit 0; `check-doc-expression-carriage` exit 0 (report-only; its one `schema-reference.md` site, `action.condition`, predates this branch); `check-changeset-claims` exit 0 (report-only); `check:pending-changeset-literals` exit 0.
- eslint, narrowed to the 14 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 14 files in the JSON report, 0 errors. Per-file warnings are equal to the base except three test files (+1, +1, +2 `no-explicit-any` from `as any` fixtures, matching those files' existing style). `eslint.config.js` has no type-aware linting (`parserOptions.project` / `projectService` are absent) and no custom rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so a verdict on an untouched file cannot move.
- Governed surface: `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over all 18 paths says NOT GOVERNED.

## Registries and docs

- Touched: `@object-ui/types` (`ObjectGridSchema` member and its zod mirror), the `plugin-grid` registration (`sort` description and docblock), `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, `packages/plugin-view/README.md`, and a changeset (`minor` on types / plugin-grid / plugin-view, never `major`).
- Not touched, on purpose: the console registry parity ledger `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`. Its `object-grid.defaultSort` carve-out entry was already harvested when spec 17.3.0 tombstoned the key; it keeps only a comment. `docs/adr/**` is not needed, because no ADR lists the key.
- `schema-reference.md`: the `CRUDSchema` `defaultSort` / `defaultSortOrder` sentence is untouched. Only the adjoining `ObjectGridSchema` sentence ("that key is unaffected"), which this change makes false, was rewritten.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface beyond the claim, with reasons. `packages/plugin-view/README.md` described the key as a working alias, and it ships in the package's `files[]`; this change makes it false, so it is repaired here. Further `plugin-view` / `plugin-grid` test files (`filterSources`, `namedViewSortArity`, `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973`, `gridDefaultFiltersLowering`, `gridRetiredStringSort-8767`, `serverSorting`) pinned the key as working, or referenced it. They sit next to the landing points.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s page-size region (draft objectui#10278) is untouched. The two edits sit in the sort `if` chain and the `declaredSort` expression; the fetch effect's dependency list is unchanged.
- Five pending changesets described how the retired key used to be honoured. They ship in the same release: objectui#4869, #6235, #8973, the #4082 grid filter-lowering entry, and #5293. Four now carry a dated note naming objectui#5861, and `5293` an inline citation (see Review rework above).
- Line-address citations in `plugin-view.mdx` paragraphs this change touched were rewritten to cite by content (AGENTS.md #11). The `data.ts:63` citation in the rewritten `gridDefaultFiltersLowering` cell was dropped.
- A document that still carries `defaultSort` renders unsorted. It is not re-routed into `sort`: that would be the tolerant alias this retirement removes.
